LanguageData.RT_T14_MainBattleTank.label: T-14 Armata MBT
LanguageData.RT_T14_MainBattleTank.description:
4th generation Russian MBT with unmanned turret, isolated crew capsule, high-power 125mm 2A82-1M cannon, and 12.7mm Kord RWS.
<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Commander x1, Gunner x1 <color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel
<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> - 125mm 2A82-1M Cannon: 125mm 3OF82 (HE), 125mm 3BK29M (HEAT), 125mm 3BM69 (APFSDS), 125mm 3UBK21F1 (Thermobaric) - 12.7mm Remote Kord RWS: 12.7x108mm cartridge (FMJ / AP / HE / Sabot)
